gaps.sentence: Do not be ___ (PATIENT) with the trainees — everyone learns at a different pace.
gaps.explanation: 'Do not be impatient' — the negative adjective fits the advice against frustration.

gaps.sentence: You will need written ___ (PERMIT) to enter the site.
gaps.explanation: 'Written permission' — the noun you can be given in writing.

gaps.sentence: He was ___ (SUSPECT) of fraud last year.
gaps.explanation: 'Was suspected of' — passive; 'suspicious' describes a person who suspects.
People are satisfied; things are satisfying or satisfactory.

gaps.sentence: The project's ___ (FAIL) was due to poor planning.
She beat three hundred ___ (COMPETE) for the title.
gaps.hint: plural noun: the people she beat
gaps.explanation: 'Three hundred competitors' — plural noun for the people taking part.

gaps.sentence: ___ (FORTUNE), the package had already been delivered.
gaps.explanation: The sentence adverb is 'Fortunately' — luckily for us.
